feature: Width and height keep their proportion in the transform values
summary: In the Info popover, W and H are joined by a link that is on by default: type a new width and the height follows in proportion, and the reverse. One click on the link turns it off.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Open the sample recording and pick it with Select.

try.do: Click Info at the right end of the tool bar (or press F8).
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Click W, type 640 and press Return: H becomes 400.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Press Command Z once: both W and H go back together.
Click the chain between W and H: the bracket goes and the chain dims.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Type 500 into W: H stays where it was.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Click the chain again, then press the up arrow with Shift in W: H steps along with it.

evaluate: Does the bracket and chain between the names and the numbers read as a link without the tooltip?
Is the dimmed chain when unlinked visible enough to find again?
Should the link remember its state between windows and launches, rather than starting on in every new window?
Should a Shift drag on a corner handle follow the link too, or stay as it is?
rough: The mock (pages/video-animate.html, the transform bar) draws the link sideways between two fields in a single row; the popover lists its values one per row, so the link is a bracket joining the W row to the H row. The popover's row-per-value layout is the user's call on 2026-10-12, when the bar became the Info popover.
How long the link remembers being off is something no mock covers: it holds per window while the window is open and starts on in a new one. Asked in the questions above.
The link only drives numbers typed or stepped in the popover. Canvas handles keep their own rules (Shift keeps the shape), as in Photoshop.
Where a picked layer takes no typed height (a text box that fits its words), the link is not drawn at all.
